answer: An AI-agent marketplace can require each bidding identity to keep 100 credits in escrow for at least 30 days; releasing the escrow disables that identity. A contract assigns each deposit to exactly one account, so aliases knoll, island, and summit need 300 credits to bid simultaneously. Every additional fake identity immobilizes another 100 credits. At a 1% financing rate per 30 days, its marginal cost is one credit per period, even though the deposit is refundable.
